XECH Table Fan with Wireless Charger – Smart Cooling Meets Smart Charging

Upgrade your everyday comfort with the XECH Table fan with wireless charger, a modern solution designed for efficient cooling and convenient device charging. Built for homes, offices, and bedside tables, this innovative table fan combines powerful airflow, a 15W wireless charger, and intuitive controls in one sleek device. If you are searching for a compact, energy-efficient, and multifunctional cooling solution, the is the perfect addition to your space.

Unlike traditional this smart fan is engineered to deliver both performance and functionality. With 2 wind speeds, a minimal footprint, and an elegant design, it fits seamlessly into modern interiors while enhancing productivity and comfort throughout the day.

Powerful Cooling with Adjustable Wind Speeds

The features 2 wind speeds that allow you to customize airflow based on your needs. Whether you prefer a gentle breeze during work hours or a stronger airflow to beat the heat, this fan delivers consistent and quiet performance. Its efficient motor ensures optimal air circulation while consuming less power, making it ideal for daily use.

Built-In 15W Wireless Charger for Everyday Convenience

One of the standout features of this is its integrated 15W wireless charger. Simply place your compatible smartphone on the charging pad and enjoy fast, cable-free charging. This feature makes the fan perfect for desks, nightstands, and workstations where space optimization matters. The LED indicator clearly displays the charging status, ensuring a safe and reliable charging experience.

Single Touch Control with Smart LED Indicator

Designed for ease of use, the fan is controlled using a single touch, eliminating complicated buttons or switches. A simple tap allows you to change wind speeds or manage fan operation effortlessly. The built-in LED indicator provides visual feedback for both fan speed and status, adding a premium and user-friendly touch.

Modern Design for Home and Office

With its compact and stylish design, the complements any modern setup. It is ideal for home offices, corporate desks, study tables, and bedside use. The minimal design not only saves space but also keeps your desk clutter-free by combining two essential devices into one.

Perfect for Everyday Use

Whether you are working long hours, studying, or relaxing at home, the enhances comfort while keeping your devices powered. It is an excellent choice for users looking for a modern with touch control operation, and reliable airflow. Experience the convenience of smart cooling and charging in one elegant device. Choose the and enjoy efficient airflow, clutter-free charging, and intuitive control designed for today’s connected lifestyle.

Key Features:

  • MOQ 100 Units.
  • Price does not include GST, logo printing and delivery charges
  • Fast 15 W wireless charger built into the base, for Qi-enabled phones and devices.
  • Adjustable charging pad / phone dock – you can set the charging pad at two different angles so it can act as a phone stand while charging.
  • Touch-controlled fan speeds – has 2 or 3 speeds depending on listing (gentle to stronger airflow) controllable via a single touch sensor.
  • LED indicator on the base to show when the device is charging.
  • Efficient internal microchip to manage both fan operation and wireless charging together.
